result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B leads with the main causes, mixed decimals and the trailing unit, and orders its fixes by impact: same decimals, unit moved to the header, then tabular figures. It hedges correctly about the font it cannot see. A contradicts itself about Verdana's figures (first proportional, then tabular by default) and puts proportional digits first. It also treats moving the unit to the header as optional and says an in-cell unit is fine. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A correctly identifies mixed decimals and the trailing unit as the main cause. It puts its fixes in order of impact, moves km into the header and hedges about the font, though it oddly lists mixed precision as a 'secondary' problem. B contradicts itself by saying first that Trebuchet MS and Verdana both default to proportional digits and then that Verdana has tabular figures by default. B also leads with the font fix and treats moving the unit to the header as optional, keeping km in its example output.
